class.name: rp1_swerve_controller/RP1SwerveController
class.description: Swerve-drive controller for rp1: claims 4 drive velocity command interfaces and 4 steering position command interfaces (named via the drive_joints/steering_joints parameters), subscribes geometry_msgs/TwistStamped on ~/cmd_vel. Skeleton stage -- update() does not yet compute swerve inverse kinematics or the 0/90-locked and 2-wheel operating modes from rp1-specs/requirements.md; see the package README for status.
